## 📦 Installation

```bash
npm install @jodetx_dev/secureshield-web
```

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Modern Bundlers & Frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue 3, Vite, Webpack)

SecureShield provides native ES module (`ESM`) and CommonJS (`CJS`) builds with complete TypeScript declarations:

```typescript
import { SecureShield } from '@jodetx_dev/secureshield-web';

async function initSecurity() {
  const sdk = await SecureShield.init({
    tenantId: 'your-tenant-id',
    appId: 'your-web-app',
    serverUrl: 'https://security.yourcompany.com/api/v1/telemetry/ingest',
    environment: 'production'
  });

  // Run a synchronous detection scan across 83 granular security probes
  const report = sdk.runScan();
  console.log('Detection verdict:', report.verdict, 'Risk score:', report.risk_score);

  // Ingest telemetry into the security gateway (client-side only)
  const result = await sdk.ingestTelemetry();
  console.log('Ingest status:', result.status);
}

initSecurity();
```

### 2. CommonJS (Node / SSR)

```javascript
const { SecureShield } = require('@jodetx_dev/secureshield-web');

// Full CommonJS support with conditional type mappings
```

### 3. Standalone Browser Drop-in (Script Tag / CDN)

For plain HTML pages, CMS platforms, or legacy web applications, load the pre-bundled IIFE distribution directly into `<head>`. It exposes `window.SecureShield` (and alias `window.SecureShieldSDK`):

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Protected Application</title>
  
  <!-- Standalone IIFE bundle with Subresource Integrity (SRI) -->
  <script 
    src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@jodetx_dev/secureshield-web/dist/secureshield.iife.min.js" 
    async>
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <script>
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
      const sdk = await window.SecureShield.init({
        tenantId: 'your-tenant-id',
        appId: 'your-web-app',
        serverUrl: 'https://security.yourcompany.com/api/v1/telemetry/ingest',
        environment: 'production'
      });

      const report = sdk.runScan();
      console.log('Scan completed:', report.verdict);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

## 📁 Package Artifact Structure

The published npm package is lean, contains **zero third-party runtime dependencies**, and emits exactly 6 files in `dist/`:

```
@jodetx_dev/secureshield-web/
├── dist/
│   ├── index.mjs                    # Native ES Module entry point
│   ├── index.cjs                    # Native CommonJS entry point
│   ├── index.d.ts                   # Bundled TypeScript declarations (ESM)
│   ├── index.d.cts                  # Bundled TypeScript declarations (CJS)
│   ├── secureshield.iife.min.js     # Production-minified standalone browser bundle
│   └── secureshield.iife.min.js.sri # Subresource Integrity SHA-384 sidecar
├── LICENSE                          # Enterprise Commercial Software License
├── README.md                        # Quick start and API documentation
├── INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md             # In-depth architectural integration guide
└── package.json                     # Modern package manifest with conditional exports
```
